description: This file contains Go source code for unit tests related to a WebRTC client implementation, including test helpers, mock observers, and test cases for initial message sending and answer generation.

classes.name: TestObserver
classes.description: A mock observer for WebRTC DataChannel events and errors used in testing.

methods.name: OnADBDataChannel
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new WebRTC data channel is established.

methods.name: recvWithTimeOut
methods.description: Receives a message from a channel with a timeout, reshaping it to the expected type.

methods.name: TestClientSendsInitialMessage
methods.description: Test that verifies the WebRTC client sends an initial request-offer message within a timeout.

methods.name: TestClientGeneratesAnswer
methods.description: Test that verifies the WebRTC client correctly generates and sends an answer after receiving an offer.
